name: sap_grasp_large
source: Basis Set Exchange (sap_grasp_large, version 1, data from S. Lehtola); fits from Lehtola, Visscher, Engel, J. Chem. Phys. 2020, 152, 144105, optimized against numerical Dirac-Coulomb Hartree-Fock potentials
convention: V_A(r) = -Z_A/r + sum_k c_k erf(sqrt(alpha_k) r)/r; each term is the potential of a unit-integral Gaussian g_k=(alpha_k/pi)^(3/2) exp(-alpha_k r^2); the stored coefficients c_k sum to -Z_A, i.e. they are the negative of the screening (electron) density expansion, cf. Eq. 16 of the SAP-X2C paper
